item.title: Worldview Weekly — August 29, 2026
item.description: Worldview Weekly. August twenty-ninth, twenty twenty-six. This rerun follows the current editorial rules: a fourteen-day candidate pool, strong source diversity, and a deliberate effort to widen the frame beyond the usual American and British magazine circuit. This week’s issue centers on three overlapping questions. First, how governments are responding to fiscal pressure, industrial competition, and technological dependence. Second, how geopolitical power is being redistributed across Europe, China, the Global South, and Asia.
